name: 01901 · Lynn, MA
findings: ZIP 01901 (Lynn) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01901 (Lynn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
